in_marathi.name: Kaumudi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaumudi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kaumudi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kaumudi', which means 'golden rain'. This name is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. According to mythology, Kaumudi represents the graceful shower of golden coins that Goddess Lakshmi bestows upon her devotees.
